wasm.reason: RFC 0026 FB-3b fix-forward: a closure captures a String PtrLen (rodata literal) alongside an Int; the lifted fn body copies the two-word PtrLen into the Out struct's label field (exercising the two-word env store + entry load + construct-store path) and computes value from the captured Int. The env-layout coupling between the String and Int captures makes a one-word defect visible through the Int result. The String PtrLen itself is not directly observable through the output frame in this slice (a computed final cannot mix with outlined fns / closures). The in-process evaluator does not yet execute user-defined pure fn calls / first-class closures, so the Node embedded-engine observation is authoritative until KR6.8.
